gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2017 was 31.923m (USD). The financial statements do not present an explicit gross prior-year reserve movement figure; movements in claims outstanding are disclosed as aggregate gross movements for the year (including current year activity). The report notes adverse development and an early distribution on the 2015 year of account which led to a collectable pre-distributed amount. No quantified gross prior-year release or strengthening is presented separately in the movement notes, so an aggregate prior-year development figure cannot be reliably extracted from the disclosures.
